atom_map_policy: When target molecules carry atom maps, mapped query atoms must resolve to the same map number; unmapped targets retain compatibility behavior.

rust.command: cargo test -p chematic-rxn --offline --lib query --quiet && cargo test -p chematic-rxn --offline --test cross_binding_contract --quiet

python.command: maturin build --release -m crates/chematic-py/Cargo.toml -o /private/tmp/chematic-py-current-wheel && python3 -m pip install --no-deps --target /private/tmp/chematic-py-current /private/tmp/chematic-py-current-wheel/chematic-1.0.10-cp313-cp313-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl && PYTHONPATH=/private/tmp/chematic-py-current python3 -c 'import json, chematic; d=json.load(open("validation/cross_binding_contract.json")); c=d["reaction_smarts_contract"]["cases"]; assert [chematic.reaction_smarts_match(x["smarts"],x["reaction"]) for x in c] == [x["matches"] for x in c]'

boundary: This covers bounded presence matching, including disconnected component assignment without target-molecule reuse, reactant/product and agent alternatives with OR semantics, detailed matched-agent reporting, and map-aware matching when target maps are present. Query-aware product construction remains outside this contract.
